_readme: RFC-0002 §2b's six known bugs, as a machine-runnable acceptance test.
Decision 2 keeps these six unfixed in the consumer repositories on purpose: they
are the survey's acceptance test, and a survey that does not surface them has not
earned trust. This file is the scorecard for that, so the number cannot regress
quietly — issue #114 scored 4 of 6 the first time it was run by hand.
It lives in docs/ and not in plugins/backend-suite/ because every expectation here
names a specific real project. The scorer that reads it (bin/score_acceptance.py)
carries none of that: project roots are supplied on the command line, so nothing
in the universal plugin knows these repositories exist.
Read-only against both projects: `survey --check` writes nothing and `doctor`
name: RFC-0002 §2b — six known bugs

projects.portal: the consumer whose profile predates four directories and a router
projects.mobile: the consumer whose schema copy has drifted from the plugin's

expectations.bug: portal declares no routesFile despite having a router
expectations.consequence: /review-docs check C is silently inert there — the governing principle violated in production

expectations.bug: portal declares no otherSharedDirs; four exist on disk
portal's profile states it ships no imagery; six JPEGs exist
the tokens object lacks additionalProperties: false
assets.palette is a string in the schema and an object in mobile's shipping profile
expectations.consequence: the schema does not describe reality

expectations.bug: the two consumer profile.schema.json copies have drifted from the plugin's
